name: Warning Shot
description:
The daily life the people desperately cling to melts away in a single massive rumble. 
<Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery> Once fully charged, deals area True damage to both allies and enemies, centered on the friendly unit with the highest Block. 
Environmental Conditions: 
Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery starting energy is increased, and DP regeneration rate is decreased.

abilities.text: Will be reborn as a <Touch of the Sanguinarch> after falling in battle for the first time
Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)
Units blocking it gain +1 Block (up to a maximum of +6)
